ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid fraud: A deeper look
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, focusing on cases and potential systemic issues.
questions: How widespread is Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What are the systemic issues leading to fraud?
ideas.insight: Understanding the scope and causes of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota could lead to significant improvements in healthcare and financial management.

ideas.title: The impact of data breaches on financial security
ideas.description: Explore the consequences of data breaches, such as the one at Figure Lending Corp, on individuals and the financial system.
questions: What are the immediate and long-term effects of data breaches on individuals?
How can financial institutions better protect against data breaches?
ideas.insight: Analyzing the impact of data breaches can inform better security practices and policy changes.
